acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p jmap-mail-server keyword passes; clippy clean; all 7 test cases pass
description:
RFC 8621 §4.1.1: keywords must be 1-255 bytes, printable ASCII %x21-%x7e (33-126), must NOT contain ( ) { ] % * " \, and MUST be stored/returned in lowercase. Current code in build_email_from_create (email.rs ~line 720), handle_email_import (~line 984), and handle_email_copy has no validation beyond deserialization. jmap-mail-types is LOCKED so validation goes in jmap-mail-server.

Algorithm:
1. In src/email.rs add fn validate_keywords(kws: &HashMap<Keyword,bool>) -> Result<(), SetError>
2. For each key where value=true: check len 1-255, check all bytes in %x21-%x7e, check no forbidden chars ( ) { ] % * " \, normalize to lowercase
3. Return SetError::new(SetErrorType::InvalidProperties).with_description() on first violation
4. Call validate_keywords() in build_email_from_create after deserializing keywords
5. Call validate_keywords() in handle_email_import after parsing keywords (~line 984-1001)
6. Call validate_keywords() in handle_email_copy after parsing keywords (~line 1242-1255)
7. MemoryBackend needs no changes

Defensive rules: treat all keyword input as untrusted; reject at boundary before storage; no unwrap() on keyword parse; forbidden char list must be exhaustive.

Tests (in tests/integration.rs):
- keyword_256_chars_rejected: keyword of length 256 → invalidProperties (oracle: RFC §4.1.1 max=255)
- keyword_255_chars_accepted: keyword of length 255 → succeeds
- keyword_with_open_paren_rejected: keyword '(' → invalidProperties
- keyword_with_crlf_rejected: keyword containing \r → invalidProperties  
- keyword_normalized_to_lowercase: create with keyword 'SEEN' → get returns 'seen'
- empty_keyword_rejected: empty string key → invalidProperties
- valid_dollar_keyword_accepted: '$seen' → succeeds
- keyword_max_ascii_char_accepted: keyword using 0x7e (~) → succeeds
title: Email: keyword validation (length, chars, lowercase)
